DEEP PIXEL-PERFECT AUDIT AND FIX. Compare every detail of the navbar and footer against the Webflow source and fix ALL discrepancies. No planning — read, compare, fix.

Project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/`

## Process
1. Read the Webflow HTML: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` — extract the EXACT navbar (class `header-sec`) and footer (class `footer`) HTML
2. Read the Webflow CSS: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` — grep for EVERY class used in the navbar and footer and note the exact CSS values
3. Read the current Next.js components:
   - `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
   - `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
   - `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`
4. Compare EVERY property: padding, margin, font-size, font-weight, line-height, letter-spacing, color, background, border, border-radius, shadow, gap, width, height, max-width, z-index, position, display, flex properties, grid properties, transitions, hover states
5. FIX every discrepancy by editing the files

## What to check specifically:
- Banner strip: exact padding, font-size, colors, link style
- Logo: exact width (130px?), link behavior
- Nav links: exact font-size, weight, color, spacing between links, hover color
- Dropdown cards: exact width, padding, border-radius, shadow values, border color
- Service items in Solutions dropdown: icon sizes, text sizes, spacing, coming-soon badge colors
- Login button: exact padding, border style, font-size, font-weight, border-radius, hover transition
- Schedule Demo button: exact gradient, padding, border-radius, font-size, arrow icon positioning
- Hamburger: exact size, border-radius, line widths/spacing
- Footer: exact background color, section padding, max-width
- Newsletter card: exact gradient, border, border-radius, box-shadow, inner spacing
- Email form: exact input styling, button positioning, placeholder color
- Social icons: exact size, background, border-radius, spacing
- Footer links: exact columns, font-size, color, opacity, hover color, spacing
- Copyright bar: exact background, padding, border-radius, font-size

Also check responsive behavior at breakpoints: 991px, 767px, 479px — read the CSS media queries for all navbar/footer classes.

## Rules
- Use Edit tool for surgical fixes, Write only if major rewrite needed
- Match Webflow CSS values EXACTLY — don't approximate
- Remove any hardcoded values that don't match the source
- Clean up unused code
- No `any` types
- Keep structure clean and readable

FIX EVERYTHING. Don't just report — fix it.
